description:
Here are the descriptions of the provided plots, following your guidelines:

The plot illustrates the metric scores for different model variants in a hate speech detection study. The x-axis is labeled “Model Variants” and displays categorical values: “Full model (ours)”, “w/o Prompt”, “w/o Augmentation”, “w/o Attention”, and “w/o Prompt & Augmentation”. The y-axis is labeled “Metric (%)” with a linear scale ranging from 57 to 66, with tick marks at intervals of 1. 

A blue line, marked with circular data points, represents “Precision”. Starting at a value of 65.45 at “Full model (ours)”, it declines to 60.16 at “w/o Prompt”, increases to 62.63 at “w/o Augmentation”, decreases to 62.22 at “w/o Attention”, and finally declines to 57.74 at “w/o Prompt & Augmentation”. A teal line, marked with diamond data points, represents “Recall”. It begins at 65.44 at “Full model (ours)”, decreases to 59.64 at “w/o Prompt”, increases to 61.06 at “w/o Augmentation”, declines to 59.67 at “w/o Attention”, and ends at 56.82 at “w/o Prompt & Augmentation”. A purple line, marked with square data points, represents “F1-score”. It starts at 66 at “Full model (ours)”, decreases to 60.16 at “w/o Prompt”, increases to 62.78 at “w/o Augmentation”, declines to 62.03 at “w/o Attention”, and finishes at 59.17 at “w/o Prompt & Augmentation”.
